description_en: Queries the backup sets for an instance
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-backups --db-cluster-id am-bp18934i73vb50000 --backup-id 1679758862 --start-time 2011-06-01T16:00Z --end-time 2023-02-20T02:30Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --remote false --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackups

parameters.description_en:
